lines.text: How many time? Say how much time!
Many learners say: How many time do you need?
Better: How much time do you need?
Time is one thing, so say much.
The second! How much time do you need?

data.wrong: How many time do you need?
data.right: How much time do you need?
data.why: Time is one thing, so say much.

native.tip: نقول «كم وقت»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول how much time: “How much time do you need?” وليس “How many time do you need?”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “How many time do you need?” 😅 في العربية نقول «كم وقت» بكلمة «كم» وحدها، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول how much مع time، فالجملة الصحيحة “How much time do you need?” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “How much time do you need?” — نقول how much مع time. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: In Arabic we say «كم وقت» with the one word «كم», but in English we say how much time: “How much time do you need?” not “How many time do you need?”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “How many time do you need?” 😅 In Arabic we say «كم وقت» with the one word «كم», but in English we say how much with time, so the right sentence is “How much time do you need?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
